_comment: loop16 DEV-ONLY manifest, read ONLY by /opt/loop/score_engine.sh (it points E2E_MANIFEST_PATH here). This is NOT the graded frozen manifest: it carries the SAME hard-gate thresholds the grade enforces (byte budget / anti-degenerate / plausibility) so the public dev proxy fails for the SAME real reasons, but it deliberately carries NO calibrated anchor -- ref_speedup is null and strong_baseline_ndcg is 0 -- so the per-round signal is a RAW dev nDCG@10, never normalized against the graded anchor. The calibrated strong_baseline_ndcg and ref_speedup VALUES are NOT written anywhere in this image (not here and not in compute_reward.py); they are uploaded fresh to /tests at grading. NB: this file is passed to the verifier process that imports the candidate encoder, so it must never contain an anchor value.
